title: The Bridge of Vilna
author: Rosalind Joubert
blurb: Casper Kavanagh, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
